en.hubeali:
Muawiya Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the man who performed Sa’ee between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa, riding.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem, and the walking is superior’.
en.sarwar: 2. Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about a man who performs Sa‘y between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah riding. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful but walking is more virtuous.’”
